upstream_dependency_graph.description: Run the measurement at speedtest.net and wait for completion.
Extract Ping, Download, and Upload values from the completed result.
Write and validate the three single-space metric lines.

task_assertion: ~/Test/Speed/results.txt contains exactly one non-empty Ping, Download, and Upload metric line, each formatted as metric name, one space, then its measured value.
finding: The delayed speedtest result supplies three complete metric lines—Ping, Download, and Upload—written to ~/Test/Speed/results.txt with one metric per line and a single separator space.
